The '''Nova-Tech Powersuit''' was a basic [[Power armor/Legends|power armor]] manufactured by [[Nova-Tech]]. It was a solid set of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] at a reasonable price, with an in-built [[blaster cannon]].<ref name="GFT" />
